Presetnatural: Gentler suppression to preserve speech details; more noise may remain.
Presetstudio: Balanced suppression without EQ or compression.
Presetpodcast: Clearer speech with a low-frequency filter and compression.
Presetmax: Stronger suppression may affect speech details.
BalancedHint: 60 ms buffer: a good starting point for most devices.
StableHint: 100 ms buffer: tolerates scheduling jitter with more latency.
FastHint: 30 ms buffer: less latency, with a higher risk of dropouts.

ClippingDetail: Lower the microphone level in Windows or reduce input gain.
GapDetail: Stop processing and try More stable; close CPU-heavy apps.
Slow: Processing is near its real-time limit
SlowDetail: Each frame lasts 10 ms; try RNNoise if the counter increases.
HealthyDetail: If speech still crackles, try Softer sound; the denoising model may be responsible.
PreservedGate: The current speech gate setting is preserved during processing.
DirectRouting: This output plays audio directly. For calls, select CABLE Input. Use headphones.
WaitingDataDetail: No new measurements have arrived. Check the microphone connection and Windows permissions.
ErrorModelMissing: DeepFilterNet3 model is missing. Reinstall the complete application folder.
ErrorModelIntegrity: The DeepFilterNet3 model file is damaged or does not match the expected version.
ErrorAbi: Update the entire application folder; the DeepFilterNet library version does not match the application.
ErrorOldNative: The DeepFilterNet library is outdated. Extract the new version into a new folder and run it from there.
ErrorMissingNative: The DeepFilterNet library is missing. Reinstall the complete application, or select RNNoise.
ErrorNativeArch: The DeepFilterNet library must be built for Windows x64.
ErrorModelMetadata: The model does not match the required 48 kHz sample rate and 10 ms frames.
ErrorOverload: Processing or the audio device cannot keep up in real time. Try RNNoise or close CPU-heavy applications.
